final: WITH per_name AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg FROM per_name) SELECT p.event_name, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.mean_avg AS above_mean, p.avg_amount / o.mean_avg AS ratio_to_mean FROM per_name AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.mean_avg ORDER BY p.event_name
